name: November Pack
description: Gemini-designed levels, verified solvable by the solver, easy to expert.

levels.name: Z-Bounce
levels.hint: Ricochet off the ceiling, then the right wall to navigate the rock around the central barrier.

levels.name: Timed Gate
levels.hint: Wait for the laser to power down before you fire through the gap. The attractor will bend your path to the miner.

levels.name: Gravity Well
levels.hint: Aim wide of the barrier; the attractor's pull will curve your rock straight into the miner.

levels.name: High Ceiling
levels.hint: Bounce your rock off the overhead truss to reach the miner.

levels.name: Cushion Shot
levels.hint: Bounce off the right wall to bank your rock around the blocker.

levels.name: Fresh Coat
levels.hint: Paint the rock blue to match the miner's color quota.

levels.name: Prism Trap
levels.hint: Use the pull field to orbit through the paint zones and slingshot into the purple miner.

levels.name: Repel Cushion
levels.hint: Aim low through the gap; the repel field will bend your shot upward and flatten it into the miner.

levels.name: Grand Slingshot
levels.hint: The massive gravity well will bend your rock's path into a wide arc around the central barrier.

levels.name: Blue Streak
levels.hint: Paint your rock blue to deliver it to the blue miner.

levels.name: Spectral Loop
levels.hint: Loop around the gravity core to gather two different pigments before making your delivery.

levels.name: Spectral Loop
levels.hint: Loop through the attractor to pick up both red and yellow paint to create orange for the miner.

levels.name: Chrono Slalom
levels.hint: Time your shot so it slips through the rotating blades while the laser is powered down.

levels.name: Color Mixer
levels.hint: Collect both yellow and blue paint to create green. Use the gravity well to curve your trajectory through both clouds.

levels.name: Blade Dance
levels.hint: Time your shot perfectly to slip through the rotating blades in the corridor.

levels.name: Gravity Dance
levels.hint: The repulsor kicks you wide into the attractor's grip, bending your path around the obstacle.

levels.name: Chroma Vortex
levels.hint: Orbit the vortex to collect red and blue paint, then time your shot to dodge the spinning blades.

levels.name: Gravity Slingshot
levels.hint: Curve your rock around the blue gravity well to reach the miner behind the wall.

levels.name: Gravity Assist
levels.hint: Release your rock high and let the attractor curve it over the barrier and into the harvester.

levels.name: Double Ricochet
levels.hint: Bounce off the ceiling girder, then the floor girder to navigate around the central barricade.

levels.name: The Hook
levels.hint: Aim high over the girder and let the blue attractor pull your rock down into the miner.

levels.name: Laser Gate
levels.hint: The laser spans the entire corridor. Speed up or slow down your shot so the rock crosses the gate while it's powered down.

levels.name: Laser Chasm
levels.hint: Time your shot perfectly. The launch speed controls when the rock arrives at the blinking laser.

levels.name: Blade Gap
levels.hint: Time your shot to pass through the spinning blades.

levels.name: Gravity Slingshot
levels.hint: Ride the massive puller to bend your path around the girder, then use the repeller to bounce into the miner.

levels.name: Ricochet Run
levels.hint: Bounce the rock off the ceiling and floor trusses to reach the miner.

levels.name: Prime Blend
levels.hint: Yellow rocks can turn green if you take the scenic route through the blue paint.

levels.name: Laser Rhythm
levels.hint: Adjust your launch speed to time the laser, then use the attractor to bend your path around the solid barrier.

levels.name: Prism Slingshot
levels.hint: Use the pull field to orbit the gravity well, picking up two primary colors before heading to the miner.

levels.name: Speed Trap
levels.hint: Adjust your launch speed to time your arrival perfectly through the blinking laser gate.

levels.name: Orbital Mix
levels.hint: Loop the attractor to pick up two colors for the purple miner.

levels.name: Gravity Swing
levels.hint: The colossal puller will sling your rock in a wide arc around the wall and into the miner.

levels.name: Second Coat
levels.hint: Your yellow rock needs a splash of blue to turn green before reaching the miner.

levels.name: Alloy Alley
levels.hint: Launch your yellow rock into the pull field to mix it with blue paint before hitting the green miner.

levels.name: High Bounce
levels.hint: Bank your rock off the top truss to sail over the barrier.

levels.name: Mix Lab
levels.hint: Your blue rock needs a splash of yellow to satisfy the green miner.

levels.name: Vector Shift
levels.hint: Angle your shots carefully to bounce through the maze of girders.

levels.name: Gravity Well
levels.hint: Ride the massive puller's gravity to whip your rock around the barrier and into the miner.

levels.name: Neon Blades
levels.hint: Time your shot through the spinning blades, and use the pull field to guide the rock to the green miner.

levels.name: Blade Rhythm
levels.hint: Time your shot perfectly to slip past the rotating blades and stay out of the laser's active cycle.

levels.name: Gravity Assist
levels.hint: Slingshot around the massive attractor, then bounce off the repeller to reach the miner.

levels.name: Prism Trap
levels.hint: Pass through the red field, then the blue field. Use the gravity well to curve into the miner, but time your shot to avoid the laser.

levels.name: Orbital Swing
levels.hint: Use the gravity well to bend your shot around the wall and into the mine.

levels.name: Triple Bank
levels.hint: Bank off the top ceiling, the right wall, and the lower angled girder to reach the miner. Time your shot past the spinner.

levels.name: Heavy Gravity
levels.hint: Massive gravity wells warp straight lines. Loop around the giant attractor and use the repelling bumpers to slingshot into the miner.

levels.name: Roof Bounce
levels.hint: Ricochet your rock off the ceiling truss to clear the center wall and hit the miner.

levels.name: Narrow Passage
levels.hint: The capture relay holds your rock and launches it through the small opening in the girders.

levels.name: Red Slingshot
levels.hint: Use the gravity well to bend your shot around the girder, avoid the blue paint, and hit the red painter before the goal.

levels.name: Blade Gate
levels.hint: Time your shot perfectly to slip through the moving blades while the laser is down.

levels.name: Gravity Slalom
levels.hint: Ride the puller's curve through the gap, then catch the repeller's boost to reach the miner.

levels.name: Gravity Slalom
levels.hint: Use the pull device to bend your shot over the barrier, then let the capture node launch you through the gap.

levels.name: Double Bank
levels.hint: Ricochet off both girders to weave through the gap.

levels.name: Ricochet Ravine
levels.hint: Ricochet precisely between the opposing girders to navigate the ravine and reach the miner.

levels.name: Heavy Orbits
levels.hint: Navigate the giant gravity well by balancing the pull towards the center and the repelling bumpers.

levels.name: Prismatic Rebound
levels.hint: Ricochet off the ceiling truss and pass through both color fields to create the color required by the miner.

levels.name: Corner Kick
levels.hint: Shoot past the wall and bounce off the top girder to reach the miner.

levels.name: Prismatic Bounce
levels.hint: Girders are bouncy. Ricochet off the top beam, then the bottom beam, passing through both painters.

levels.name: Overpass
levels.hint: Bank your rock off the top truss to clear the vertical wall and drop into the miner.

levels.name: Bumper Bank
levels.hint: Shoot over the center wall, bank off the ceiling, and thread the gap to the miner.

levels.name: Angle Alley
levels.hint: Bank your shot off the angled trusses to navigate the rock safely past the spinning blades.

levels.name: Cushion Corner
levels.hint: Bounce your rock off the top girder to clear the central wall and reach the target.

levels.name: High Road
levels.hint: Aim high and bank off the ceiling to bypass the central blockade.

levels.name: Chromatic Bank
levels.hint: Bank off the upper and lower girders in sequence, passing through both painters to create the purple rock required by the miner.

levels.name: High Bounce
levels.hint: Bank your rock off the top truss to clear the wall and reach the miner.

levels.name: Prism Bounce
levels.hint: Ricochet off the ceiling into the color mixer, then bank into the target.

levels.name: High Bounce
levels.hint: Ricochet off the ceiling girder to clear the middle wall and land in the miner.

levels.name: High Bank
levels.hint: Bank high off the ceiling girder to bypass the solid wall and hit the target.

levels.name: Dead Aim
levels.hint: Ride the pull into the catcher and let the auto-aim line up the gap.

levels.name: High Bank
levels.hint: Bank your rock off the ceiling girder to bypass the central wall and thread between the spinning blades.

levels.name: Truss Dance
levels.hint: Time your shot through the laser gap, then string together bank shots to reach the far corner.

levels.name: Repel Pivot
levels.hint: Use the repulsor to kick your rock upward into the attractor's field, bending it around the wall.

levels.name: Split Path
levels.hint: Aim high to curve through blue, or low to curve through red; both need yellow first.

levels.name: Chromatic Split
levels.hint: Release into the puller to loop through the painters. Grab yellow then blue for green, or red then blue for purple.

levels.name: Dual Palette
levels.hint: Use the gravity well to curve your shot through the correct color stations for each miner.

levels.name: Gravity Loop
levels.hint: The massive puller will bend your shot up through the paint; then the repeller kicks it to the target.

levels.name: Prismatic Trap
levels.hint: Loop around the core to snatch two colors, but time your throws to dodge the blades.

levels.name: Capture Relay
levels.hint: The capture node grabs your rock and slingshots it over the top of the wall.
